serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
After that we prepared Annalie’s workspace. 
My back hurts after moving all those tables, tools, and mannequins…
I kind of wanted to leave all of that to {f_botName} since she doesn’t get tired, but Annalie could’ve noticed something.
Well, more importantly, she would think of me as a garbage human being for using my girl to do all the work…
I hope Annalie will succeed at this fashion show. Her friend in a flashy outfit seems like she needs to be knocked down a peg or two. 
She said some rude stuff even about {f_botName}, but I didn’t want to butt in, it’s Annalie’s fight.
There’s still a lot of work to do, I wonder how it all will turn out.
She asked me to come to her shop with {f_botName} soon, we shouldn’t keep her waiting.
